versions.content: A reboot detect ed with Session ID and Reboot Flag shall lead to expiration of the local state that is controlled by this communication partner. In case of a reboot of a server, of which the client uses a service, the client shall handle the reboot as if a Stop Offer ent ry was received (see also SWS_SD_00367 for further details) In case of a reboot of a server, of which the client uses a service, the server shall handle the reboot as if a Stop Subscribe Eventgroup entry was received (see also Specification of Service Discovery AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 30 of 182 Document ID 616 : AUTOSAR_SWS_ServiceD iscovery - AUTOSAR confidential - SWS_SD_00345 for further detai ls).
